headline: Kazatomprom Reports 16.4% Revenue Rise to 1.39 Trillion Tenge in Jan-Sep
summary: Kazakhstan's national atomic company Kazatomprom recorded revenue of 1.389 trillion tenge ($3.03 billion) in the first nine months of 2026, up 16.4% year-on-year.
why: Kazatomprom is the world's largest uranium producer; its financial performance reflects global nuclear fuel demand and prevailing contract prices.

impacts.name: Kazatomprom
impacts.why: Higher revenue demonstrates strong commercial performance in uranium sales.
